description: Search universities worldwide by name and/or country using the Hipolabs API. Returns name, country, state/province, web pages, and email domains. At least one of name or country must be provided.

country.description: Country name to filter by (e.g., "United States", "United Kingdom")

name.description: University name or partial name (e.g., "Harvard", "MIT"). Accepts query, q, university, school as aliases.

name: search_universities
